about: Fights hand to hand and blade to blade: clashes, blocks on wood and metal shields, punches, kicks, fast swipes, falls, cracks, armour hit, a parry and a club to the head.
notes: v4 library (2026-11-15 night): many takes of many sounds, picked by measure and kept for the team to choose from, trim and wire. Nothing in the catalogue asks for these yet unless it says so.

prompts.text: Two steel swords clash: a bright ringing clang, five separate clashes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

block/wood.want: a blow on a wooden shield

prompts.text: A heavy blow lands on a wooden shield: a hollow solid thud, five separate blocks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

block/metal.want: a blow on a metal shield

prompts.text: A sword strikes a metal shield: a loud resonant clang, five separate blocks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A hard punch lands on a body: a meaty slapping thud, six separate punches with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A hard kick lands on a body: a heavy thump, five separate kicks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

swipe.want: a fast swipe through the air

prompts.text: A fast swipe through the air: a sharp short whoosh, six separate swipes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A blow lands on plate armour: a dull heavy metallic clank and rattle, five separate hits with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A sword parries a blow with a quick scraping ring of steel sliding on steel, five separate parries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A wooden club bonks someone on the head: a hollow knocking thunk, five separate bonks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy blow sends a body flying: a deep whumping thud and a tumbling scrape, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
